## Local3D — Character from views

This graph is the official **Pixal3D multi-view** workflow. Instead of one turnaround sheet it takes four separate pictures of the SAME subject (front, left, back, right: the camera moves 90 degrees between views, same distance, same pose). Each picture is cut out and framed on its own, exactly as the template does. *Front + back only* uses just two views.

Generated or invented views are NOT a substitute: if the views disagree, the model averages them and the result gets blurry or warped (measured in docs/CHARACTER_ROUTING_DECISION.md). Upstream: Comfy-Org/workflow_templates (MIT).
